subject: English
question_text: Use capitals and punctuation marks where necessary in the following text.
stimulus: the man said to me where are you going i am going to school said i did you go to school yesterday no i replied why didn't you go i was very busy said i Part−B : Composition [40 Marks]
guide_solution: Capitalization and punctuation The man said to me, "Where are you going?" "I am going to school," said I. "Did you go to school yesterday?" "No", I replied. "Why didn't you go?" "I was very busy", said I. Part−B : Composition See SSC English Made Easy To Test Papers Book 212
